tools.name: angular_list_nodes
tools.description: List live registered nodes with compiler or runtime-dom provenance. Read exact instance IDs, current fields, options, schemas and validation before acting.

tools.name: angular_read_model
tools.description: Read one registered control model from its actual public Angular control as bounded JSON data. Use this to inspect selected objects without trial mutations. Password/hidden/file values and getters are excluded; complete=false means the value is unavailable.

tools.name: angular_read_view
tools.description: Read the current visible UI hierarchy, including exact live registry IDs and nearby row text. Use it to distinguish repeated actions without guessing selectors or business ownership.

tools.name: angular_describe_node
tools.description: Read a live registered Angular node. A source ID shared by repeated instances requires an exact instance ID.

tools.name: angular_fill
tools.description: Fill an exact live control using its original DOM interaction path. Angular owns validation. This may trigger application input/change effects.

tools.name: angular_activate
tools.description: Activate an exact live action through its original UI event. Dispatch does not establish business success.

tools.name: angular_submit
tools.description: Fill exact registered controls and submit their live form through the original Angular submission path. Return validation and dispatch evidence; business outcome remains unknown.

tools.name: angular_press_key
tools.description: Focus an exact registered, enabled native or ARIA control and send a real browser key such as Space, Enter or ArrowDown. This supports keyboard-accessible readonly widgets without bypassing their original handlers.

tools.name: angular_upload_file
tools.description: Choose files on an exact registered native file input through original browser file/change events. Supply explicit file bytes; application upload and validation handlers remain authoritative.

tools.name: angular_navigate
tools.description: Open a path on the same application origin. This changes page state and rebuilds the live node registry.
